documentation.description: Raw conversion records ingested from conversions.jsonl. A conversion is the moment a free user becomes a paying customer; the ongoing subscription lifecycle after this moment lives in subscription_events.

fields.name: user_id
fields.description: User who converted

fields.name: conversion_date
fields.description: Conversion date, YYYY-MM-DD

fields.name: plan
fields.description: Plan purchased at conversion: pro or enterprise

fields.name: mrr
fields.description: Monthly recurring revenue (USD) at conversion

fields.name: signup_date
fields.description: Denormalized signup date for convenience

fields.name: days_to_convert
fields.description: Days between signup and conversion

fields.name: used_real_time_collab
fields.description: Legacy flag from the source system (superseded by usage facts)

fields.name: ingestion_timestamp
fields.description: When the row was loaded into bronze

documentation.description: Raw product feature release log ingested from feature_releases.json. Contains initial releases and later version upgrades of the same feature, which feed the SCD Type 2 feature_states dimension.

fields.name: feature_id
fields.description: Stable feature identifier (shared across version upgrades)

fields.name: feature_name
fields.description: Machine name of the feature (e.g. real_time_collab)

fields.name: release_date
fields.description: Release date of this version, YYYY-MM-DD

fields.name: version
fields.description: Version label (v1.0, v2.0, ...)

fields.name: ingestion_timestamp
fields.description: When the row was loaded into bronze

documentation.description: Raw product telemetry ingested from feature_usage_events.jsonl, partitioned by event_date. Each row is a single user interaction (view/use/share) with a feature.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Surrogate event identifier generated at ingestion

fields.name: user_id
fields.description: User who performed the interaction

fields.name: feature_id
fields.description: Feature interacted with

fields.name: feature_name
fields.description: Denormalized feature machine name

fields.name: event_type
fields.description: Interaction type: view, use, or share

fields.name: event_timestamp
fields.description: When the interaction happened

fields.name: event_date
fields.description: Calendar date of the interaction (partition column)

fields.name: ingestion_timestamp
fields.description: When the row was loaded into bronze

documentation.description: First-touch marketing attribution ingested from marketing_attribution.jsonl. Roughly 5% of signups have no record (direct traffic, lost UTM parameters); downstream joins default those users to 'unattributed'.

fields.name: user_id
fields.description: Attributed user

fields.name: channel
fields.description: Acquisition channel: organic_search, paid_search, paid_social, content_marketing, referral, partner, outbound

fields.name: campaign
fields.description: Campaign within the channel (e.g. google_brand, webinar_series)

fields.name: first_touch_date
fields.description: Date of the first tracked touch, YYYY-MM-DD (on or before signup)

fields.name: ingestion_timestamp
fields.description: When the row was loaded into bronze

documentation.description: Append-only subscription lifecycle log ingested from subscription_events.jsonl — the shape billing systems (Stripe, Chargebee) emit. Every plan or seat change carries the MRR before and after, which makes revenue movement analysis a simple delta.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Unique event identifier (monotonic per generation run)

fields.name: user_id
fields.description: Customer the event belongs to

fields.name: event_date
fields.description: Event date, YYYY-MM-DD

fields.name: event_type
fields.description: subscription_started, plan_upgraded, plan_downgraded, seats_expanded, seats_contracted, or subscription_cancelled

fields.name: plan
fields.description: Plan after the event (null for cancellations)

fields.name: mrr
fields.description: MRR (USD) after the event; 0 for cancellations

fields.name: previous_plan
fields.description: Plan before the event (null for subscription_started)

fields.name: previous_mrr
fields.description: MRR (USD) before the event (null for subscription_started)

fields.name: ingestion_timestamp
fields.description: When the row was loaded into bronze

documentation.description: Raw user registrations ingested from user_signups.jsonl, partitioned by signup_date. Firmographic attributes (company size, industry) come from the signup form.

fields.name: user_id
fields.description: Unique user identifier

fields.name: email
fields.description: Signup email (synthetic; excluded from silver for privacy)

fields.name: signup_date
fields.description: Signup date, YYYY-MM-DD (partition column)

fields.name: industry
fields.description: Industry: technology, finance, healthcare, retail, education, manufacturing

fields.name: ingestion_timestamp
fields.description: When the row was loaded into bronze

documentation.description: Slowly Changing Dimension (Type 2) tracking feature version history. Version upgrades close the previous record (effective_to) and open a new current one. Point-in-time state is answered with WHERE date >= effective_from AND date < effective_to.

fields.name: feature_id
fields.description: Stable feature identifier

fields.name: feature_name
fields.description: Feature machine name

fields.name: version
fields.description: Version label in force during the interval

fields.name: is_enabled
fields.description: Whether the feature was enabled (always true in current data)

fields.name: effective_from
fields.description: Start of the validity interval (release date)

fields.name: effective_to
fields.description: End of the validity interval; 9999-12-31 for current records

fields.name: is_current
fields.description: True for the record currently in force

fields.name: record_hash
fields.description: md5(feature_name|version) used for change detection

documentation.description: Per-user, per-feature usage summary aggregated from raw telemetry. first_used_date is the key column for adoption-before-conversion analysis.

fields.name: user_id
fields.description: User

fields.name: feature_id
fields.description: Feature

fields.name: first_used_date
fields.description: First interaction date (adoption moment)

fields.name: last_used_date
fields.description: Most recent interaction date

fields.name: total_usage_count
fields.description: Total interaction events

fields.name: avg_daily_usage
fields.description: total_usage_count / days between first and last use (inclusive)

fields.name: as_of_date
fields.description: Snapshot date the fact table was built

documentation.description: Periodized subscription lifecycle - each row is a (plan, mrr) state valid from period_start until the next event at period_end. Cancellations close the previous period without opening a new one, so churned customers have no active period. Point-in-time revenue questions use WHERE date >= period_start AND date < period_end.

fields.name: user_id
fields.description: Customer

fields.name: plan
fields.description: Plan in force during the period (pro or enterprise)

fields.name: mrr
fields.description: MRR (USD) in force during the period

fields.name: period_start
fields.description: Date the state took effect

fields.name: period_end
fields.description: Date the next event superseded it; 9999-12-31 if none

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: True for the customer's current, non-cancelled state

fields.name: change_type
fields.description: Subscription event type that opened the period

documentation.description: The user dimension. Combines signup firmographics, first-touch marketing attribution, and the current commercial state derived from the latest subscription lifecycle event. This is the main join target for user-level analysis.

fields.name: user_id
fields.description: Unique user identifier

fields.name: signup_date
fields.description: Signup date

fields.name: industry
fields.description: Industry vertical

fields.name: acquisition_channel
fields.description: First-touch channel; 'unattributed' when no tracking record exists

fields.name: acquisition_campaign
fields.description: First-touch campaign; 'unattributed' when no tracking record exists

fields.name: current_plan
fields.description: free (never converted), pro, enterprise, or churned (subscription cancelled)

fields.name: current_mrr
fields.description: MRR (USD) of the active subscription; 0 for free/churned users

documentation.description: Acquisition funnel quality per channel per signup cohort - which channels bring users who actually convert, how fast, and at what revenue. Includes the 'unattributed' bucket so totals reconcile with overall signups.

fields.name: signup_month
fields.description: First day of the signup month (cohort)

fields.name: acquisition_channel
fields.description: First-touch channel, or 'unattributed'

fields.name: signups
fields.description: Users who signed up in the cohort

fields.name: conversions
fields.description: Of those, users who later converted to paid

fields.name: conversion_rate
fields.description: conversions / signups

fields.name: avg_days_to_convert
fields.description: Average signup-to-conversion days (converted users only)

fields.name: total_new_mrr
fields.description: Total MRR (USD) acquired from this cohort at conversion

fields.name: avg_new_mrr
fields.description: Average MRR per conversion

documentation.description: Cohort analysis answering "does feature adoption drive conversion?". For every feature, users are split into used_feature / available_not_used / not_available cohorts and conversion outcomes are compared across them. The ratio of conversion rates between the first two cohorts is the feature's conversion lift.

fields.name: feature_name
fields.description: Feature machine name

fields.name: cohort
fields.description: used_feature, available_not_used, or not_available

fields.name: total_users
fields.description: Users in the cohort

fields.name: converted_users
fields.description: Users in the cohort who converted to paid

fields.name: conversion_rate
fields.description: converted_users / total_users

fields.name: avg_days_to_convert
fields.description: Average signup-to-conversion days (converted users only)

fields.name: avg_mrr
fields.description: Average MRR at conversion (converted users only)

documentation.description: Monthly MRR waterfall decomposing revenue growth into new business, expansion, contraction, and churn, with net revenue retention. Internally consistent by construction - ending_mrr = starting_mrr + net_new_mrr every month.

fields.name: month
fields.description: First day of the month

fields.name: starting_mrr
fields.description: MRR at the start of the month (previous month's ending)

fields.name: new_business_mrr
fields.description: MRR from subscriptions started this month

fields.name: expansion_mrr
fields.description: MRR gained from upgrades and seat expansion

fields.name: contraction_mrr
fields.description: MRR lost to downgrades and seat contraction

fields.name: churned_mrr
fields.description: MRR lost to cancellations

fields.name: net_new_mrr
fields.description: new_business + expansion - contraction - churned

fields.name: ending_mrr
fields.description: MRR at the end of the month

fields.name: new_customers
fields.description: Subscriptions started this month

fields.name: churned_customers
fields.description: Subscriptions cancelled this month

fields.name: net_revenue_retention
fields.description: (starting + expansion - contraction - churned) / starting. Excludes new business (standard SaaS NRR). NULL for the first month.

documentation.description: Weekly engagement metrics per feature - weekly active users, event volume, intensity, and each feature's reach as a share of the overall weekly active base (pct_of_wau).

fields.name: week_start
fields.description: Monday of the ISO week

fields.name: feature_name
fields.description: Feature machine name

fields.name: active_users
fields.description: Distinct users of this feature during the week

fields.name: total_events
fields.description: Usage events for this feature during the week

fields.name: events_per_active_user
fields.description: total_events / active_users (engagement intensity)

fields.name: weekly_active_users
fields.description: Distinct users across ALL features that week (overall WAU)

fields.name: pct_of_wau
fields.description: active_users / weekly_active_users (feature reach)
